title: A Competing C-Terminal beta-Turn Controls Frame-Dependent Stability of Collagen Triple Helices.
authors: Naha, Aritra; Ghosh, Amar; Sarma, Bani Kanta
one_liner_zh: 该文通过DFT、NMR、X射线和MD研究胶原三螺旋C端β-转角构象对框架依赖稳定性的影响，虽以胶原蛋白为对象并涉及结构计算，但核心是实验表征辅以计算，方法创新性有限。
abstract: Frame-dependent stability of collagen triple helices is well documented, but its structural origin remained unresolved. Here we identify a C-terminal beta-turn-like conformational state with intramolecular CO...HN contacts as the competing motif governing this behavior. In POG-frame collagen mimetic peptides, a C-terminal primary amide promotes this beta-turn-like state via transient intramolecular CO...HN contacts involving the proline carbonyl, reducing its availability for interstrand hydrogen bonding and perturbing terminal polyproline II geometry, directly opposing triple-helix assembly. N-methylation or esterification suppresses beta-turn formation, enhancing stability by up to 7.5  degrees C. Conversely, beta-turn formation is disfavored in the GPO frame, where the same terminal amide reinforces interstrand hydrogen bonding. Density-functional theory, NMR, X-ray crystallography, circular dichroism, and molecular dynamics establish this structural basis. Trends across 20-22 residue collagen-mimetic peptides confirm the mechanism arises from local C-terminal interactions, independent of length. These findings reveal how terminal hydrogen-bonding interactions encode competing conformations modulating peptide folding and supramolecular assembly.
abstract_zh: 胶原蛋白三螺旋的框架依赖性稳定性已有充分文献记载，但其结构起源仍未解决。在此，我们鉴定出一种具有分子内CO...HN接触的C端β转角样构象状态，作为调控该行为的竞争性基序。在POG框架的胶原模拟肽中，C端伯酰胺通过涉及脯氨酸羰基的瞬时分子内CO...HN接触促进这种β转角样状态，减少其用于链间氢键的可用性，并扰动末端聚脯氨酸II几何结构，直接对抗三螺旋组装。N-甲基化或酯化抑制β转角形成，将稳定性提高至多7.5摄氏度。相反，在GPO框架中β转角形成不利，其中相同的末端酰胺增强链间氢键。密度泛函理论、核磁共振、X射线晶体学、圆二色性和分子动力学确立了这一结构基础。20-22残基胶原模拟肽的趋势证实该机制源于局部C端相互作用，与长度无关。这些发现揭示了末端氢键相互作用如何编码竞争性构象，从而调节肽折叠和超分子组装。
